constraints.hierarchy_note: one op-list can edit SEVERAL files: the envelope's 'sheets' map + per-op 'sheet' tags route ops onto declared child .kicad_sch files in one atomic transaction (run backup + `undo --run`); a child .kicad_sch is also still a normal single-file draw target. A sheet instantiated more than once needs per-instance references (instance_designators — a scalar ref refuses INSTANCE_REFS_REQUIRED). An op naming a sub-sheet path directly still fails HIERARCHICAL_UNSUPPORTED: route by 'sheet' tag instead

conventions.dry_run: plan never writes; draw writes only with --apply
conventions.version_stamps: every JSON object payload carries schema_version or a family version field (protocol_version, journal_version); the documented exceptions are array payloads (jlc search, calc batch) and name-keyed tables (calc list, expected)
conventions.json_errors: with --json, a failing command that would otherwise leave stdout empty emits {"error": {code, message, exit, remediation}} on stdout; that covers argparse usage failures (unknown command/flag/choice → code USAGE) and unexpected exceptions (code INTERNAL); plan/draw op-list errors emit the normal draw-result shape with status refused
